title: Special counsel costs defending a fire captain
summary: In March 2025 a committee backed raising outside lawyer pay to defend a fire captain in a lawsuit from $50,000 to $200,000, noting state law requires the defense. In August 2026 Resolution 26-131 would add $250,000, to $450,000, for special counsel representing Captain Scott Martin in a lawsuit filed by Chelsea Evans.

timeline.text: A deputy corporation counsel said state law requires defending firefighters sued for acts done on duty.
